theater: 小亞細亞（龐提斯、卡帕多西亞）

battle.name: 第一次米特里達梯戰爭
battle.theater: 小亞細亞（龐提斯、卡帕多西亞）
battle.brief: 公元前89年，龐提斯王密特里達梯斯六世進軍卡帕多西亞，擊敗亞細亞總督森索里努斯，逐走羅馬扶植的阿里奧巴贊內斯；前88年蘇拉介入，議和之後再起兵，86年於比堤尼亞奧爾科美努斯擊潰其遠征軍，84年以和約收場。亞述長弓雖早已消亡，其角筋木複合弓的技術仍為本役弓手所用。

kit.name: 亞述長弓
kit.history: 亞述人靠弓和鐵的組合征服兩河流域。弓兵在車上射，車兵靠弓兵開路。

countries: 第一次米特里達梯戰爭是公元前89年至前84年之間羅馬共和國與龐提斯王國的一場戰爭，交戰地帶集中在小亞細亞東北部的龐提斯、卡帕多西亞、帕夫拉戈尼亞與比堤尼亞一線。龐提斯一方是黑海南岸的希臘化王國，國王密特里達梯斯六世以辛諾普的宮廷為中樞，握有王國常備步兵、國王馬廄裡的騎兵、由希臘人、色雷斯人與高盧人組成的僱傭兵，以及一支裝備護胸鎧甲與馬頸鎧的重騎兵；希臘化軍制以步兵方陣為骨幹，配以投射兵、輕裝步兵與車載砲兵，攻城則依靠回轉式攻城塔與配重投石機。羅馬一方是共和國本身，作戰主力是亞細亞行省的羅馬軍團與羅馬盟友比堤尼亞王尼科美德三世、卡帕多西亞王阿里亞拉特斯六世、帕加馬王歐門涅斯二世提供的部隊，另僱用克里特、羅得與敘利亞的弓手以及投石手。羅馬的指揮體系在這場戰爭中經歷兩次更替：公元前89年由亞細亞行省總督昆圖斯·馬爾基烏斯·森索里努斯以行省軍權應戰，兵敗後元老院改派執政官盧基烏斯·科爾涅利烏斯·蘇拉赴亞細亞，公元前88年授以非常指揮權，戰後再以特別協定收束。雙方在亞細亞的角力，實質是羅馬要把卡帕多西亞與比堤尼亞的繼承權固定在親羅馬的君主手上，而密特里達梯斯要憑一個統一的希臘化王國名義，把整片東安納托利亞收進自己的勢力範圍。
countriesEn: The First Mithridatic War was a war fought between the Roman Republic and the Kingdom of Pontus between 89 and 84 BC, with the fighting concentrated along the northeastern corner of Asia Minor, in Pontus, Cappadocia, Paphlagonia and Bithynia. On the Pontic side stood a Hellenistic kingdom on the southern shore of the Black Sea, centred on the court at Sinope under King Mithridates VI, holding the kingdom's standing infantry, the cavalry of the royal stud, mercenaries drawn from Greeks, Thracians and Gauls, and a body of heavy cavalry armoured with cuirasses and horse neck guards; the Hellenistic military system used the infantry phalanx as its backbone, supported by missile troops, light infantry and chariot-borne artillery, and siege work was done with revolving towers and counterweight stone-throwers. On the Roman side stood the Republic itself, the main strength being the Roman army of the province of Asia together with contingents supplied by Rome's allies King Nicomedes III of Bithynia, King Ariarathes VI of Cappadocia and Eumenes II of Pergamon, and with Cretan, Rhodian and Syrian archers and slingers hired for the campaign. The Roman command system changed twice over the course of the war: in 89 BC the provincial governor of Asia, Quintus Marcius Censorinus, met the emergency with his provincial command and was defeated, after which the senate sent the consul Lucius Cornelius Sulla to Asia and in 88 BC gave him extraordinary command; the war was then closed by a special settlement. The real substance of the struggle in Asia was that Rome sought to fix the succession of Cappadocia and Bithynia in the hands of kings friendly to itself, while Mithridates meant to draw the whole of eastern Anatolia inside his own sphere under the banner of a single unified Hellenistic kingdom.
people: 密特里達梯斯六世·尤帕托爾是本戰爭的當事人。他公元前120年即位，母萊奧迪刻出身老弗里吉亞王室，傳說兼為塞琉古王室的公主；他娶了自己的姊妹萊奧迪刻，藉此宣稱對馬其頓安提柯王朝與波斯貴族的雙重血統，並自認與太陽神同源，因此得了密特拉之名。卡帕多西亞王位繼承糾紛中，他扶植阿里奧巴贊內斯奪位；公元前89年亞細亞總督森索里努斯將阿里奧巴贊內斯處死，他以恢復正統為名出兵，擊敗總督的軍隊與比堤尼亞的援軍。公元前88年，蘇拉以執政官身分赴亞細亞談判，密特里達梯斯表面接受和約，同年卻殺害羅馬使者普布利烏斯·蘇爾皮基烏斯及其子，並再殺阿里亞拉特斯六世。蘇拉再任執政官後於公元前87年率六個軍團東征，前86年圍攻雅典與比雷埃夫斯，取下比雷埃夫斯的港口工事，前86年在比堤尼亞奧爾科美努斯擊潰密特里達梯斯的元帥阿爾凱勞斯，前85至84年圍困卡爾刻冬，最後議和。密特里達梯斯一方的元帥阿爾凱勞斯、策反有功的歐里斯特斯，以及被密特里達梯斯扶植的雅典僭主阿里斯蒂翁，都是決定戰局走向的人物；蘇拉麾下的盧基里奧斯·盧庫盧斯與龐培則由此役起步，前者日後在第三次戰爭中攻入亞美尼亞，後者於公元前83年攻下辛諾普，接續本戰爭未竟的事業。
peopleEn: Mithridates VI Eupator is the principal person in this war. He came to the throne in 120 BC; his mother Laodice came out of the royal house of old Phrygia and was said to be a princess of the Seleucid house as well; he married his own sister Laodice, and used that marriage to claim descent both from the Macedonian Antigonid line and from Persian nobles, and he claimed a kinship with the sun, which is where his name Mithridates comes from. In the dispute over the Cappadocian throne he backed Ariobarzanes; in 89 BC the governor of Asia, Censorinus, executed Ariobarzanes, and Mithridates marched out under the banner of restoring the rightful king, defeating the governor's army and the Bithynian auxiliaries. In 88 BC Sulla came to Asia as consul to negotiate, and Mithridates appeared to accept a settlement, yet in the same year he murdered the Roman envoys Publius Sulpicius and his son and killed Ariarathes VI again. When Sulla was consul for a second time he took up the war in 87 BC at the head of six legions; in 86 BC he besieged Athens and the Piraeus and took the harbour works of the Piraeus; in 86 BC he defeated Mithridates' general Archelaus at Orchomenus in Bithynia; and from 85 to 84 BC he besieged Chalcedon before a peace was arranged. On the Pontic side the general Archelaus, the turner of the plot Orestes, and Aristion, the tyrant of Athens whom Mithridates installed, were the men who shaped how the war turned. On the Roman side Lucullus and Pompey began here: the first would drive into Armenia in the Third Mithridatic War, the second would take Sinope in 83 BC and carry on the work this war left unfinished.
kits: 卡面上的亞述長弓是一件公元前七百年的亞述兵器，這場戰爭裡並沒有它。亞述王國在公元前612年亡於米底與巴比倫，亞述的國有軍與弓兵建制隨之消失；到公元前89年，亞述的土地已是阿契美尼德帝國的一個行省，龐提斯與羅馬之間並不存在亞述式的弓兵部隊。亞述長弓代表的那種複合弓技術卻沒有消失：以木為芯、弓背纏筋、弓腹嵌角的複合弓，在希臘化時代仍是東方世界的標準弓，史稱希臘化弓或斯基泰弓，弓身長可達一人多高，張力大、拉距長，嵌在弓臂內側的角片讓箭在離弦後仍保有力量。密特里達梯斯的軍隊是希臘化式主力加僱傭兵，弓手主要來自克里特、羅得、敘利亞與高盧，用的正是這種複合弓；羅馬一方的弓箭手則以行省輔助軍與外聘弓手為主，同樣使用角筋複合弓，並與重裝步兵的標槍、短劍相配合。真正左右本戰役勝負的並非弓，而是雙方其他裝備的差距：羅馬軍團裝備大盾與標槍，列陣密集，能以烏龜陣抵禦投射物，輔以帳幕、攻城塔、撞槌與配重投石機；龐提斯一方有裝備護胸鎧甲與馬頸鎧的重騎兵、附著鐮刃的戰車與色雷斯式輕步兵。糧秣方面，羅馬遠征軍靠騾隊與逐日紮營維持，龐提斯靠比堤尼亞與帕夫拉戈尼亞的村鎮徵糧，海上則靠羅得人提供的艦隊與本國輕快戰船爭奪黑海東岸的航路。
kitsEn: The Assyrian bow on the card is an Assyrian weapon of the seventh century BC, and it is not present in this war. The Assyrian kingdom was destroyed by the Medes and the Babylonians in 612 BC, and the Assyrian state army and its organisation of archers disappeared with it; by 89 BC Assyria was a satrapy of the Achaemenid Empire, and there was no Assyrian-style body of bowmen between Pontus and Rome. The technique the Assyrian bow stands for did survive: the composite bow with a wooden core, sinew on the back and horn let into the belly remained the standard bow of the eastern world in the Hellenistic age, known as the Hellenistic bow or the Scythian bow; the bow was more than a man's height, with high draw weight and long draw, and the horn plates let into the inner face kept the arrow driving after it left the string. Mithridates' army was a Hellenistic core supplemented by mercenaries, and its archers came chiefly from Crete, Rhodes, Syria and Galatia, and they used exactly this kind of composite bow; the archers on the Roman side were auxiliaries of the provinces and hired bowmen, using the same horn-and-sinew composite bows, working in combination with the pilum, the gladius and the shield of the heavy infantry. What really decided this war was not the bow but the gap in everything else between the two sides: the Roman legion carried the large shield and the pilum, closed ranks densely, could absorb missile fire in the testudo, and brought along the vineae, the towers, the rams and the counterweight stone-throwers; the Pontic side had heavy cavalry in cuirasses and horse neck guards, war chariots with scythe blades, and Thracian light infantry. On supply, the Roman expeditionary army lived on mule trains and a camp pitched every evening, while Pontus drew grain from the villages of Bithynia and Paphlagonia; at sea, the Rhodian fleet and Pontic light warships contested the routes along the eastern Black Sea coast.
tactics: 本戰爭的戰術可以分成三個階段。公元前89年，密特里達梯斯以混合兵種自龐提斯越過帕夫拉戈尼亞南下，先取卡帕多西亞的阿里奧巴贊內斯政權，再以多路縱隊深入，比堤尼亞與卡帕多西亞的聯軍在缺乏統一指揮下被各個擊破，羅馬亞細亞總督的退路被切斷，只能退守安納托利亞內陸。公元前88年蘇拉到任後，羅馬先把這場戰爭當作一次可以談的糾紛處理：蘇拉以執政官身分帶少量隨員赴安納托利亞談判，密特里達梯斯同意接受和約，羅馬換回卡帕多西亞王位，蘇拉隨即回國；這次以談判代替戰爭的選擇，既出於羅馬在意大利戰事與內鬥中的抽緊，也出於亞細亞冬季難以展開大軍的現實。公元前87年蘇拉再任執政官，獲六個軍團的非常指揮權，重拾戰端：他的做法是先在希臘解決同盟，於公元前86至85年攻下雅典與比雷埃夫斯，摧毀雅典人引以為傲的港口設施，斷絕密特里達梯斯在愛琴海一側的盟友與糧道；其後向東推進，在比堤尼亞境內與阿爾凱勞斯主力對峙。奧爾科美努斯的處理最能看出蘇拉的風格：阿爾凱勞斯屢次約戰，蘇拉拒絕接受對方選定的戰場與時機，只把營地逐步移近，並以堤壩分流水源，切斷對手的飲水；等龐提斯軍在高溫下缺水、士氣崩潰時才發動攻擊，龐提斯軍遂告潰散。公元前85至84年蘇拉圍困卡爾刻冬，逼密特里達梯斯以公子做人質談判，戰爭以特別協定收場。整體而言，羅馬靠的是軍團的野戰紀律、行軍營地與穩定的補給線；龐提斯靠的是騎兵迂迴、投射兵騷擾與車隊的騎兵護衛，但缺乏能承擔決定性會戰的統一指揮。
tacticsEn: The course of this war can be divided into three stages. In 89 BC Mithridates moved south from Pontus across Paphlagonia with a mixed army, first unseating Ariobarzanes in Cappadocia and then pushing in with several columns; the combined force of Bithynia and Cappadocia was defeated in detail because it had no unified command, the retreat of the Roman governor of Asia was cut off, and he could only fall back into the interior of Anatolia. When Sulla arrived in 88 BC, Rome first treated the war as a quarrel that could be negotiated: Sulla went to Anatolia as consul with a small escort, Mithridates agreed to a settlement, Rome recovered the Cappadocian throne, and Sulla went home. That choice of negotiation in place of war was forced both by the strain on Rome from the Italian war and the internal struggles, and by the plain fact that a great army could not be deployed in Asia through the winter. In 87 BC Sulla was consul a second time, received extraordinary command over six legions and took the war up again. He began by settling the Greek question, taking Athens and the Piraeus in 86 and 85 BC and destroying the harbour works the Athenians were proud of, which cut Mithridates' allies and his grain route on the Aegean side; he then pushed east and came to grips with Archelaus' main force inside Bithynia. The handling of Orchomenus shows Sulla's manner at its clearest. Archelaus repeatedly asked for battle; Sulla refused to accept the ground and the moment the enemy chose, moved his camp forward by slow degrees and dammed the stream to cut the enemy's drinking water, and only struck when the Pontic army, thirsty in the heat, had lost its nerve. The Pontic force broke. From 85 to 84 BC Sulla besieged Chalcedon and forced Mithridates to negotiate with his own son as hostage, and the war was closed by a special settlement. In general, Rome relied on the field discipline of the legions, on the marching camp and on a steady line of supply; Pontus relied on cavalry envelopment, missile harassment and mounted escort for its wagons, but it never had the single command able to carry a decisive general engagement.
data: 可核對的數字分幾類。年份：通行把這場戰爭定在公元前89年至前84年，其中公元前88年的和約是第一階段的終點，公元前87年蘇拉再任執政官後重新開戰。月份：史料只記年份不記月份，本卡月份欄按該年之始填一。兵力：普魯塔克《蘇拉傳》記蘇拉在奧爾科美努斯戰前的野戰兵力約為一萬五千步兵與一千五百騎兵，密特里達梯斯一方則為十二萬步兵與五千騎兵；這組數字出自修辭性的戰記，雙方都在誇大，仍能看出形勢差距。蘇拉自言統率的軍團為六個，另有羅得人提供的海軍與外聘的克里特、敘利亞弓手。距離與地理：卡帕多西亞首府馬扎卡（今開塞利）到龐提斯海港辛諾普的陸路約四百公里；蘇拉自以弗所向東北推進至比堤尼亞，橫貫小亞細亞的行程約一千公里，途中多在山地與冬季不宜行軍之地。事件：公元前88年蘇拉第一次赴亞細亞只帶少數隨員；同年被殺的羅馬使者普布利烏斯·蘇爾皮基烏斯是前執政官，其子隨行，一同遇害。時間跨度：從公元前89年出兵到公元前84年議和，前後約五年；若只計公元前87年蘇拉再出兵的戰役期，則約兩年。傷亡：兩軍的具體數字無可靠記載，僅有奧爾科美努斯一戰龐提斯軍死傷被俘以萬計一類的概略說法，羅馬方面也只說有相當數量的傷兵；雅典方面則記有大批雅典人被俘並淪為奴隸，各書數目不一。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked fall into several classes. The dates: the war is generally placed between 89 and 84 BC, with the settlement of 88 BC closing the first phase and Sulla reopening the war in 87 as consul a second time. The month: the sources give the year and not the month, so the month field of this card is filled with the first month of that year. The forces: Plutarch's Life of Sulla gives Sulla's field force before Orchomenus as about fifteen thousand foot and fifteen hundred horse, against Mithridates' one hundred and twenty thousand foot and five thousand horse; the figures come from a rhetorically shaped narrative and both sides inflate them, but they still show the disparity. Sulla claimed six legions under his command, together with a fleet supplied by the Rhodians and hired Cretan and Syrian archers. Distances and geography: the land road from the Cappadocian capital Mazaca, modern Kayseri, to the Pontic port of Sinope is about four hundred kilometres; Sulla's advance from Ephesus to the northeast as far as Bithynia ran to about a thousand kilometres across Asia Minor, much of it through high ground and through country that could not be crossed in winter. The incidents: on his first mission to Asia in 88 BC Sulla took only a small escort; the Roman envoy Publius Sulpicius who was killed in the same year was a former consul, and his son was travelling with him and was killed with him. The span: from the march out in 89 BC to the peace in 84 BC is about five years; counting only the campaign reopened by Sulla in 87 BC, about two. Losses: no reliable figures exist for the casualties of either army; there is only the general statement that at Orchomenus the Pontic dead and captured ran to some thousands, while on the Roman side there is only talk of a considerable number of wounded; on the Athenian side there is a record of a large number of Athenians taken prisoner and sold into slavery, the numbers differing from book to book.
cause: 打起來的原因有三層。表層是卡帕多西亞的繼承糾紛：自從羅馬在對抗塞琉古與安提柯之後把安納托利亞切成若干屬國，卡帕多西亞的王位在阿里亞拉特斯六世與阿里奧巴贊內斯之間反覆易手，羅馬承認阿里奧巴贊內斯，而密特里達梯斯正是他的支持者；公元前89年亞細亞總督森索里努斯處死阿里奧巴贊內斯，等於直接打臉密特里達梯斯，也打斷了他在東安納托利亞的佈局。深層是羅馬在東方的擴張：羅馬不肯坐視一個控制黑海沿岸、握有糧道與礦山的強國出現，因此把卡帕多西亞與比堤尼亞的傀儡政權視為屏障；密特里達梯斯在公元前90年代中期取得德爾斐安菲克提翁的主席席位，羅馬人擔心這讓他取得跨希臘世界的正當性與號召力，衝突便由王位糾紛上升為體系之爭。技術層面的原因更實在：羅馬的行省軍隊編制單一、功能固定，遇到混編的希臘化大軍就難以應付；密特里達梯斯的軍隊雖然精銳，財政卻吃緊、國土偏遠，一旦戰事拖長，他比羅馬更經不起消耗。前88年蘇拉以談判收場、前87年再以戰爭收場，也是這個結構的必然：羅馬人自己清楚，亞細亞的遠征既花錢又冒險，蘇拉的選擇是先用最小代價取回王位，再留下一個隨時可以重新檢視的對手。
causeEn: There are three layers of cause. The surface layer is the dispute over the Cappadocian succession: after Rome had defeated the Seleucids and the Antigonids, Anatolia was carved up into client kingdoms, and the Cappadocian throne changed hands repeatedly between Ariarathes VI and Ariobarzanes. Rome recognised Ariobarzanes, and Mithridates was his backer; when the governor of Asia, Censorinus, executed Ariobarzanes in 89 BC he struck at Mithridates directly and broke up the arrangements Mithridates had made in eastern Anatolia. The deeper layer is Rome's expansion in the East. Rome would not sit still and let a strong power that held the Black Sea coast, the grain routes and the mines grow unchecked, and so it treated the puppet states of Cappadocia and Bithynia as a screen. Mithridates' acquisition in the middle of the nineties of the presidency of the Delphic Amphictyony worried the Romans, who feared it gave him legitimacy and a voice across the Greek world, and the quarrel was lifted from a matter of succession to a contest of systems. The technical reasons are blunter still. The Roman provincial army was narrowly organised and fixed in function, and it found it hard to answer a mixed Hellenistic army; Mithridates' troops were excellent, but his finances were strained and his realm remote, and a long war exhausted him sooner than it exhausted Rome. That Sulla settled the matter by negotiation in 88 and reopened it by war in 87 was itself a consequence of this structure: the Romans knew perfectly well that a campaign in Asia cost money and courted risk, so Sulla's choice was to take back the throne at the least cost and then leave an opponent who could be reviewed whenever convenient.
impact: 這場戰爭的後果主要落在三處。第一，羅馬的東方政策成形。公元前84年的特別協定建立了後來幾十年羅馬對待小亞細亞的標準做法：把行省軍事權交給單一指揮官、以協定期限設定停戰條款、承認龐提斯為友邦同時保留干預的權利；到第三次米特里達梯戰爭時，這套模板被整個推翻，龐提斯幾乎被逐出黑海。第二，羅馬內部的權力格局被推高。蘇拉靠這場戰爭贏得第二次蘇拉戰爭的前哨與聲望，六個軍團的軍官與士兵帶著各自的依附關係回國，這支部隊後來變成關鍵；而龐培在公元前83年攻下辛諾普時，已經有了不必依附執政官就能獨立指揮東方戰事的資本，這正是日後龐培與凱撒對抗的原型之一。第三，經濟與航運。公元前88至84年間黑海與地中海之間的糧道及奴隸貿易中斷，希臘城市在缺糧與派系傾軋中劇烈分化，羅馬本身的糧食供應也短暫受影響，直到龐培在第三次戰爭中清剿海盜、恢復航路才緩解。此外，密特里達梯斯保住的龐提斯王國仍是非羅馬勢力在安納托利亞東部的支點，並與亞美尼亞及塞琉古餘部保持往來，這條線索一直延續到公元前63年第三次戰爭結束；龐培的戰利品把黑海東岸的希臘城邦捲入羅馬的版圖，龐提斯王國則在羅馬的干涉下逐漸淪為附庸。
impactEn: The consequences of this war fall into three places. First, Roman policy in the East took shape. The special settlement of 84 BC established the standard Roman way of dealing with Asia Minor for the decades that followed: the military command of a province handed to a single commander, a term of agreement setting the terms of the truce, the recognition of Pontus as a friend coupled with a retained right of interference. By the Third Mithridatic War this template was thrown over entirely and Pontus was driven almost out of the Black Sea. Second, the balance of power inside Rome was pushed upward. Sulla won the opening move and the renown of the Second Sullan War, and the officers and men of the six legions came home carrying their own patron-client ties with them, an army that later became decisive. Pompey, when he took Sinope in 83 BC, already possessed the capital to command a war in the East without leaning on a consul, and that is one of the prototypes of the Pompey-Caesar conflict to come. Third, economics and shipping. Between 88 and 84 BC the grain route and the slave trade between the Black Sea and the Mediterranean were cut, and the Greek cities were torn apart by shortage and by faction; the grain supply of Rome itself was briefly affected, and only Pompey's clearing of the pirates and the restoration of the routes during the Third War eased it. Beyond this, the Pontic kingdom Mithridates preserved remained the point of non-Roman power in eastern Anatolia and kept up contacts with Armenia and the remains of the Seleucid house, a thread running on until the Third War ended in 63 BC; Pompey's spoils drew the Greek cities of the eastern Black Sea into the Roman world, and the kingdom of Pontus itself declined under Roman interference into a dependency.
result: 公元前84年，蘇拉自亞細亞返回意大利之前，雙方以使節往來達成協定，戰爭以協議收場。密特里達梯斯保留龐提斯王國與博斯波魯斯海峽的統治權，放棄比堤尼亞與帕夫拉戈尼亞的部分土地，支付賠款，承認卡帕多西亞由羅馬支持的阿里亞拉特斯九世執政，並取得羅馬以友邦相待的待遇；蘇拉回到羅馬後獲得非常得勝的榮譽，此後兩度出任執政官，最終在公元前79年奪取獨裁官權，成為第一位終身獨裁者。兩年前公元前88年的那場會面，普魯塔克《蘇拉傳》記蘇拉曾在小亞細亞西北岸的營帳中設宴款待密特里達梯斯，雙方當面議出框架。密特里達梯斯保住了王國，失去的卻正是最要緊的東西：對小亞細亞的擴張通道與對黑海航線的壟斷。協議沒有解決根本矛盾，羅馬不打算讓任何一方獨佔黑海，密特里達梯斯也需要用戰果鞏固自己的正統，公元前88年那套被勉強接受的安排在公元前87至83年被雙方各自撕毀，第三次米特里達梯戰爭隨即爆發。回頭看，第一次米特里達梯戰爭的實際結果是：龐提斯沒有被消滅，羅馬也沒有取得決定性的戰場勝利，雙方都消耗了大量兵力與財政；換來的是羅馬在東方多了一個長久的敵人，也多了一套用來對付它的辦法。
resultEn: In 84 BC, before Sulla left Asia for Italy, the two sides reached a settlement through their envoys, and the war was closed by agreement. Mithridates kept the kingdom of Pontus and command of the Bosporus, gave up parts of Bithynia and Paphlagonia, paid an indemnity, recognised Ariarathes IX, whom Rome backed, as king of Cappadocia, and obtained the treatment of a friend of Rome. Sulla returned to Rome with the honours of a victory of an unusual kind, was consul twice more, and in 79 BC took the dictatorship for life, becoming the first permanent dictator. The meeting two years earlier, in 88 BC, is recorded by Plutarch in the Life of Sulla: Sulla had Mithridates invited to his tent and entertained him with wine, and the terms of the framework were discussed face to face. Mithridates saved his kingdom, but what he lost was precisely the most important thing of all: the corridor for expansion into Asia Minor and the monopoly of the Black Sea routes. The settlement settled none of the underlying contradictions. Rome had no intention of letting either party monopolise the Black Sea, and Mithridates needed victories to consolidate his own legitimacy, so the arrangement accepted under duress in 88 was torn up by both sides between 87 and 83, and the Third Mithridatic War followed. Looking back, the actual outcome of the First Mithridatic War was this: Pontus was not destroyed, Rome won no decisive field victory, and both sides consumed large quantities of men and money. What it bought was a lasting enemy in the East for Rome, and a set of methods with which to deal with that enemy.
